item: Stoplist batch 1: eighteen words of LaTeX macros, paper boilerplate, markup debris and keyboard noise
summary: The first reviewed stoplist batch from the keyword triage: en mathcal, mathbf, mathbb, mathrm, fig, supplementary, crossref, likelyno7 and ten Latin-script markup and noise tokens read in the Korean log (filed in _multilingual.yml because ko.yml holds Hangul only). Every word passed the verdict gate and the tool's own refusals; table, doi, figure, the 88 lng words and every mojibake fragment were left out by ruling. The causes the run exposed are in OPEN_QUEUE. Also repairs a break #1327 left in main: engine_text is imported by the engine module store.py, so a full index pass now loads src/monitoring, and tests/test_index_engine_stamp.py::test_every_module_a_pass_loads_is_hashed_or_triaged wants each such module triaged; both are listed in NOT_OUTPUT_AFFECTING with their reason (they only clean error text).
